summary.headline: Acknowledgments and Editorial Assistance
summary.text: Acknowledgment of scholars who lent codex copies, collations, and textual assistance, including Leo Parmentier, Joseph Laurent, Domenico Bassi, Wilhelm Kroll, Joseph Bidez, and Paul Thomas; it records help with Syriac and Arabic writers and dates the completion at Brussels on 15 November 1904.
